c4109812a742.en: The Charger provides a way to charge supported tools through the ME Network or manually using a crank. It can also be used to create Charged Certus Quartz Crystal from Certus Quartz Crystal, and Meteorite Compass from Compass.

9f0cf51b51ea.en: To craft a meteorite compass, charge a normal compass in a Charger. This can be done very early by using a Wooden Crank.The Meteorite Compass points in the direction of the nearest Meteorite within a range of 2,700 blocks. If the compass is spinning rapidly there is Sky Stone in your chunk! If the compass is spinning slowly, then you need to explore more because you're out of range of the nearest Meteorite.

f7dc1792c28d.en: Before you head out to find your first Meteorite make sure to have an Iron Pickaxe or better. Meteorites are made out of a very hard material called Sky Stone which requires it. Make sure you mine to the center of the meteorite to collect the Certus Quartz Crystals, Certus Quartz Blocks and your Inscriber Presses!

185ab298162c.en: Inscriber Presses are found in the Sky Chest at the center of a Meteorite. They can be used to create circuits in an Inscriber.

785ccf2a7207.en: Now that you have some Certus Quartz Crystals it's time to charge them. Toss one into the Charger you made earlier and get to cranking!

08efc5342684.en: This crystal possesses the unique ability to absorb and convert energy from one form to another, and is the foundation of all ME technology. Fluix Crystal is crafted by placing Charged Certus Quartz Crystal , Nether Quartz and Redstone Dust in water. It will quickly start to react, and result in a Fluix Crystal.

32e9ef50e774.en: To craft the processors required for more advanced machines, you'll need the Inscriber. Each type of processor has an associated press, which you will find in meteorites. Each operation requires 1k AE charged up.

7cbcd457f890.en: A wrench made of Certus Quartz Crystal or Nether Quartz. Useful for rotating blocks, and removing individual parts from cables.

78539fa00b73.en: A modified furnace capable of generating AE Power instead of smelting ores. When placed on an ME Network it will charge Energy Cell or power other Network Devices.The Vibration Chamber will burn almost any solid burnable fuel for power. It will slow, or accelerate the burn depending on how much power it is able to store vs what is wasted. Generates between 1 and 10 AE/t depending on its burn speed.

ac17ef2acd70.en: Stores up to 200,000 AE. They do not accept power directly, but are used to add additional power storage to an already existing ME Network.

56161a192c5a.en: Stores AE energy up to 1.6 million units. They do not accept power directly but are used to add additional power storage to an already existing ME Network.

f0a2b0dca7ec.en: The Energy Acceptor converts energy from external systems into AE and stores it in the network.The following energy systems are supported: Forge Energy / Redstone Flux 2 FE = 1 AE.

5d2948e91b03.en: A part designed to share energy between two ME Networks without sharing anything else, also used to craft Fluix ME Glass Cable.

Must be powered by an ME Network via the top or bottom, and consumes a steady 8 ae/t while plugged in. Crystal Seeds must be in an adjacent water block to be effected, the seeds will shimmer more rapidly when in the presence of a powered Crystal Growth Accelerator. Can only connect to cables, or other networked machines on the top and bottom of the machine.

cc973e1df0f3.en: A component required for making item storage cells. Storage Cells are one of the core mechanics of storage in Applied Energistics 2, there are three kinds: one for items, one for fluids, and one for regions of space. These ones store items only.

3e321915ae8b.en: The ME Chest is the simplest way to use a Storage cell, it will give you direct access to the contents of the cell placed inside. It can be powered stand alone with external power, or as part of a ME Network. When on a network, the storage of the chest will be available to any other devices in the same network using an assigned Channel. When used without a network, the chest will not transfer full stacks at once, capping transfers at 38 items instead.

ef98cf1d0fb8.en: Used to display inventories of ME Chests and to hold Storage Drives.

246a9c91e52d.en: &eHow do I know what gear to get?

df802d45f8bd.en: &7Stats, also known as attributes, are a series of numbers associated to your character which allow other things to scale from.

0ba865f5499b.en: &7For example, Haste defines how fast you attack, while health defines how much health you have, etc.

659624d2e886.en: &7The next quests will explain the main stats and how each is important for what use specifically.

07c70e6679dc.en: &eStats are a core part of your gear, it's important that you understand what stats you need and which you don't depending how you want to build yourself.

0c6465d3ea9a.en: &eCore Stats are the stats that everyone uses to an extent.

58a1eac3e6a1.en: &7Either because you already have a default amount (like Health) or because any piece of gear will give the stat (like Haste and Armor)

ea8750f81bda.en: &eVarious statistics that are designed for ranged options.

5fd8d3b67118.en: &7While Physical Damage is used by everyone, ranged builds will prefer other statistics depending on what path they take; &eArchery&7 (Ranged Physical) or &eSpellcasting &7(Ranged Magic)

a5b39c9453bf.en: &7Magic can also be used by melee, with Spellblade builds.

b7d3e2baeef1.en: &7Making you attack or switch weapons faster. It also scales with certain weapons and items. Particular focus for "Rogue" builds, or any fast attacking build.

f83e8a2549b6.en: &eIncreases the amount of damage your swings/punches deal.

4d820d6e0a9a.en: &7The main statistic for melee builds, as it increases the damage you deal and scales with anything that deals physical damage, such as melee weapons and melee abilities.

d0a5a14ba988.en: &7It's obtained from armor pieces, but enemies and bosses will also have an amount armor by default.

ac5aecb23110.en: &7Reduces the incoming &6Physical Damage&7 at a higher range. It's more effective on high damage hits, hence why it's known as the "Anti One Shot" stat.

b732dfb5d475.en: &7Increases the maximum amount of damage you can take until you die.

95b90fd21405.en: &7Decreases the amount of Energy (Hunger) you lose passively.

8cd4193ad411.en: &eElemental powers are the third strongest to exist, also known as &otertiary&r&e powers.

3ae19481bcc6.en: &7Although there are other tertiary powers, Elemental ones come from the Creation, Holy and Soul.

0d0e1e83c634.en: &eArcane, Frost and Fire&7 can be used by various Spell Books, alone or together, they're all three part of the &eAstral &7hybrid power.

f77c6c3e07aa.en: &eLightning&7 is used by some weapons like the Thunderwrath artifact, consists of an important power for Valkyries.

b8a23902a939.en: &ePrimordial Powers are the second strongest, also known as Secondary powers.

9c965a4a2239.en: &eHoly&7 is used by Priests and Paladins to support allies.

0faccf7e4b7f.en: &eSoul&7 is used in combination of Elemental powers, to form hybrid powers such as &eSoulfire&7 and &eSoulfrost&7, used mainly by some Artifacts.

aaec17c21c6e.en: &eDecaying powers are the powers of Death.

9c37f80865d0.en: &eBlood&7 is used by Blood Death Knights, a tank specialization that sustains itself.

42c8416a42c2.en: &eUnholy&7 is used by Unholy Death Knights, bruisers that bring diseases to enemies.

74828fd944c7.en: &eHybrid stats either are a mix of two stats, or a stat that applies globally to both melee and ranged classes.

1e099b0f095f.en: &eLethality and Magic Penetration are the same stat with different names. They ignore a percentage of your target's Armor or Magic Protection.

0c58b03d59a4.en: &7For example, if you have 16% Lethality and your enemy has 100 armor, you'll hit them as if they had 84 Armor instead (as it reduces their armor -16%).

6d4b8caa4c8b.en: &eAstral Power is the combination of 3 elemental powers: &dArcane, &cFire&e and &bFrost&e.

5f65ba39fc5c.en: &7This hybrid power is used by Astral Mages, or by Astral Spellblades. With artifacts such as &dSingularity&8 (from Ekavar)&7 and &dSupernova&7 scaling with these stats.

17063ccc4d6b.en: &7There are spell books that use Astral Power too, such as the &dRunic Invocations&7 book.

8be3a77ce019.en: &7Increases the specific spell power by a percentage of your Physical Damage.

dfa3a73cd717.en: &7Increases your Phyiscal Damage by a percentage of your amount of the specified spell power.

795ee44bb5ee.en: &7This stat scales the damage dealt with Ranged Weapons that throw projectiles, such as bows, crossbows or guns. It's obtained through Talents, Jewelry and from the ranged weapons themselves.

4fcaa54ceb35.en: &7This stat increases the draw speed from a bow/crossbow, or the rate of fire from guns/cannons.

f1186522e2f2.en: &eThese powers buff the casting process of Spellcaster Mages.

d7fe3940d730.en: &eSpell Critical Chance&7 increases the chance of your spells to deal critical damage.

ed205550f0da.en: &eSpell Critical Damage&7 increases the damage of your critical spells by a percentage.

a431b551a1d4.en: &eSpell Haste&7 increases the speed of your casts, making them shorter.

ba076ed27e3a.en: &7It also scales with other things like Rolling.

becf682a9791.en: &eEnchantments are a core part of your gear, they heavily increase the efficiency of your gear.

fa3a25213fad.en: &eProtectors (Also called Tanks) are supports that focus on protecting others by taking the damage from enemies.

c0d102e83456.en: &7Protectors focus towards being the first to attack enemies, or taunt them using active talents such as &9Bone Armor&7.

71a962f4c758.en: &7As a protector your main priority should be &cMaximum Health&7 and &eArmor&7. The best pieces with these stats are &eDiamond Armor&7 and its upgrades, as they'll provide the maximum amount of Armor points (and Toughness) as possible, and later on also Maximum Health.

17e83b4f2ec3.en: &eKeep in mind that a tank's damage is mediocre compared to other builds. Its purpose is to tank, not to deal damage.

a411e74fcc72.en: &eWarriors are melee builds that swing slow but hard.

4ad6c8adb3a9.en: &7They are the definition of a "Burst" class; as although they swing slow their damage will be high, just not as constant as a DPS build.

c6a99074624d.en: &eMages are versatile ranged builds that use magic of certain elements such as Arcane, Fire and Frost.

4b3dcfe8ac98.en: &7A Mage's job is to deal damage from a distance using magic casted from a Spell Book.

3338d1d1b220.en: &7Your priority will depend on the path you decide to take; the element your want to focus on. As starting gear, you can get a &eWizard Staff&7 (or any staff of the specific element) and &eWizard Robes&7.

faca677e7478.en: &eUnlock Tier II Guides for Specific Elements

29b710a2da8c.en: &eRogues are melee builds that focus on attacking fast, dealing constant damage to targets.

fd55e8a98e06.en: &7They are the definition of a "DPS" class; the focus is towards constant damage, unlike Burst builds which are focused towards high damage without being constant.

a28e60fb61fc.en: &7Stat-wise the main priority is &eHaste&7, then &6Physical Damage&7. Gear-wise you should look for fast attacking weapons that are one-handed so you can dual wield them.

8ca8e24331ff.en: &eRangers are ranged builds that use weapons such as Bows, Crossbows or Guns to deal damage using projectiles.

34e96160143b.en: &7They can be built as a DPS-oriented build, or Burst-oriented build, depending on the gear you take and stats you prioritize.

cd504cb6721e.en: &7Main priority is &2Ranged Damage&7, obtained from talents and the gear you're using. If you want a faster fire rate, then you should also prioritize &aDraw Speed&7.

17880a563a89.en: &eKeep in mind that archers are squishier.

ca412b450b7e.en: &eAn alternative path that combines both Rogues and Mages.

13537451e941.en: &7With spellblades you can be a melee rogue that uses magic abilities. You can start with a Spellblade of any element you'd like, and its Techniques spellbook for the abilities.

4e4d8a4b3e38.en: &7Priorities should be a mix of both Physical Damage and the elemental power of your choosing. Fate choice can be either the fate of your element, or &9Shadow Techniques&7 if focusing more on attacking than spells.

fa888a133488.en: &eThe Runic Invocations use Astral Magic, power from three elements: Arcane, Fire and Frost.

b832267089f0.en: &7Runic Invocations are very strong when used right, but are the most difficult mages.

3b1bfb66d80b.en: &7Now that you've reached enough level to get a Fate Talent, you should choose &9Knowledge Of Runes and Stars &7as it provides &eAstral Power&7.

eb67a20337e9.en: &eHealers are supports that protect their allies by healing and giving magical temporal shields.

20165b1756be.en: &7Your main focus is &eHoly Power&7, obtained through talents and gear. You can use the &6Holy Book&7 to cast healing spells.

09d7c52d081b.en: &7You might also focus on a bit of defense, such as maximum health or movement speed to escape from targets, as your damage won't be as high.

b715c7529e61.en: &eKeep in mind that a healer's damage is mediocre compared to other builds. Its purpose is to heal, not to deal damage.

405711967e1a.en: &eBards are supports that buff allies with damage, haste, healing and other buffs.

bcd1b9b8fd9d.en: &cYou need to be in a party with your allies to give them buffs! &8(/openpac-parties command)

0fb2e035dc26.en: &7Bards are special, as they don't have a specific gear or stat. The only requirement is to have the &9A Bard's Tale&7 talent fated. They can use specific instruments to give specific buffs as described in the talent itself.

8c28a1c87a20.en: &7The short answer is hybrid. You can mix a Bard with another build or however you'd like. For example, you can be a support with damage by going into Archery gear, or mage, or healer! It's up to you.

c9bd56b38835.en: &eUnlock Tier II Frost and Healer Guide

fafc731a12d6.en: &eFrost focuses on dealing moderate damage while providing utility such as slowing down enemies.

d0c403b73f30.en: &7Besides Frost Power, its main focus is &eSpell Haste&7 to cast as fast as possible. &eCritical Chance and Damage&7 are also good stats, although not a priority.

56b328f7fa79.en: &eArcane is a high damage element focused on slower but harder spells.

6431049b6d44.en: &7It's the Burstiest of all 3. Focuses on &eCritical Damage&7 to maximize damage dealt by critical spells. &eCritical Chance&7 is also important, balancing out both is a good idea.

943aa7c27117.en: &7Your next upgrade if you choose to go as a Haste Rogue. The Assassin Set provides +5% Haste per piece, making it ideal for your build.

0e5475619ace.en: &7Physical Damage and Haste nodes should be top priority. For fate, choose &9Shadow Techniques&7 as it increases your Haste by a lot.

318e37727533.en: &7Your next upgrade is the Ranger Armor, as it provides the highest Ranged Damage, useful for your build.

3613aa36bbc2.en: &7Shortbows or Rapid Crossbows are the best options for DPS due to their low draw speed.

07251c41b775.en: &7Pick all Ranged Damage options and as a Fate, get &9Sin'dorei Heritage

4e9d748826b4.en: &7Longbows or Heavy Crossbows are the best options for Burst due to their high damage. Alternatively you can use a Veiled Crossbow for slightly faster draw speeds.

ce8f84ff25d7.en: &eThe next upgrade comes from killing a Mutant Skeleton to get its chestplate.

d566cf3acefd.en: &7On the weapon side, you can also upgrade your Shortbow/Rapid Crossbow. For the accessories side, get the respective necklace and rings.

cf7c27991249.en: &eThe next upgrade is getting a better burst-oriented weapon.

b12950702d18.en: &7You should upgrade to a Crystal Longbow / Ruby Heavy Crossbow. For the accessories side, get the respective necklace and rings.

6a58025244ff.en: &7As an upgrade, you can obtain the Prior set, which increases your holy power by a percentage instead of flat, boosting your Staff's Holy Power.

9480f8da5ac6.en: &7On Tier IV, you should obtain the &6Orion &7artifact, as it's the only bow artifact.

2e8aad7e70b8.en: &7You can also branch out to three different spellbooks that interact directly with Orion depending on its upgrade tree;

f095a6ea7e35.en: &eFire is a high damage element that doesn't provide utility but provides very high damage with high critical chance focus.

7a8d7d3e79af.en: &7As a Fire mage you deal high constant damage but lack of high burst options, to mitiage this you can focus more on &eCritical Damage&7, but your main priority should be &eCritical Chance&7 to have crits as constant as possible.

fff3176f7a3e.en: &7Your next upgrade as a tank is switching from Diamond to Netherite.

46f5ba134308.en: &7You can choose &9Righteous Hammers &7for a more dps focus, or &9Bone Armor&7 for pure resistance with a taunt.

74d3370589c7.en: &7As for Fate, your main focus should always be &9S'kellak's Blessing&7.

ab8960110ce0.en: &7Netherite-Diamond will be your preferred upgrade from Netherite so you can upgrade to Sapphire afterwards.

f8f86b4efb7e.en: &7Sapphire Armor is the direct upgrade from Netherite-Diamond, it has less total armor but provides +20 Maximum Health per piece, and a passive that reflects damage dealt to you. This means you take 30% less damage than with any other Armor from the getgo.

3893f0a01686.en: &7Tank is a very versatile class and go many other artifacts, but the armor is a massive staple for any tank player.

8c28d095e250.en: &7Upgrading your Holy Staff is an essential step before moving to your Artifact Weapon.

f3cd6e880b67.en: &7Obtain the &9Ekavar&7 Artifact Weapon and use its Upgrade Tree to evolve it to &eAd'anel, Secret of Ain&7.

bdaa83096069.en: &7Now that you've reached enough level to get a Fate Talent, you should choose &9Frost Archmage &7over anything.

87cfdd6ecf00.en: &7Now that you've reached enough level to get a Fate Talent, you should choose &9Fire Archmage &7over anything.

c7dbdec349ad.en: &7Now that you've reached enough level to get a Fate Talent, you should choose &9Arcane Archmage &7over anything.

54594a5d7170.en: &7The Magus Set is your next upgrade for armor, crafted from Magus' drops, recommended for level 50 onwards, as Magus is a Void's Invasion Chapter II boss.

9869adb632db.en: &7A Mageseeker Hat can be used if you want to proritize critical damage.

fba412346388.en: &7Many artifacts can be used as Spellblades, as most also grant a spell power of a kind. For fire, you have &6A'zhar&7. For Frost, you have &6Frostmourne&7. For Fire \& Arcane, you have &6Ash'edar&7, and finally, for Astral you have &6Supernova&7.

17e8e08cdf8e.en: &eThe final choice for all mages is Ekavar, the Great Cinderstone Staff.

fd93e8f337b7.en: &7The difficulty will depend on the previous Spell Book you chose in Tier III.

48635565bd0b.en: &7Your next upgrade for Spellblades are the Runic armor sets, along with alternative spellblade spellbooks.

51d23a4112c6.en: &eElemental Wizards are proficent in three elements; Fire, Frost and Arcane.

db7a94c00fa2.en: &7Your damage will not be as high as a devoted mage, but you will be very versatile, and later on obtain the means to cast multiple elements at once, known as &dAstral Magic&7.

df0596178e56.en: &7Souldancer becomes your next upgrade after Assassin, as it provides the highest Haste out of any armor set of this tier.

642153c67439.en: &7An alternative path of the Rogue is a Monk, which uses Fist weapons. You can get a Fist of Fury for those builds.

4afb5cabdf55.en: &eDeath Knights are warriors who fell into Death's Call.

9f8c0a3eb88f.en: &7They can be high attack speed DPS focused (Frost), or Burst and AoE focused (Unholy).

dfab80136e65.en: &7Their main weapon are Runeblades, as they provide all three Death Knight powers.

ee1792af3279.en: &7The third Death Knight type is Blood. It's a tank class, that's why it's not included in this path. If you're interested in it, go towards the Protector's Path instead.

4ff4881c542f.en: &eUnholy Death Knights are a Burst and AoE focused class.

f143e99b42d2.en: &7Your preferred weapons are two handed Great Runeblades. For armor, choose the Plaguebringer set, which you will keep on future tiers.

97865789d3e0.en: &eFrost Death Knights are DPS builds that deal a mix of physical and frost damage.

c43584458de7.en: &7Your preferred weapons are one handed Runeblades, and the Frozen Chamption armor set, which you will keep for future tiers.

efabdc40ba82.en: &7For armor, upgrade it to the netherite tier, as they'll be the best for damage and protection.

5cf96bd9e984.en: &6Frostmourne&7 is made for Death Knights, making it the best choice for any Death Knight build.

ef1815460413.en: &eBlood Death Knights have less protection, but high health and self-sustain.

087305a63fe0.en: &7This is an alternative route to going full protection, and instead focusing on sustaining yourself using the Tome of Vampiric Knowledge.

815a8b58e807.en: &7For artifact choice, you have &6Fury of a Thousand Fists&7 for monk builds, or &6Ash'edar&7 for swordman builds. A dagger artifact is coming in the future.

6817720a02b7.en: &eArtifact Option: &6Fury of a Thousand Fists &e(Monk's Way)

8ab4f1627b00.en: &eTitan's Shroud &7is your preferred armor because it has the highest &6Physical Damage &7stat, which is your main priority.

ad4858a89e34.en: &7For an artifact choice, &6Thunderwrath&7 is the best as it interacts directly with the &9Warrior's Devotion&7 fate.

ee59ae41d07b.en: &7You can also make &eHero's Armor&7 as an alternative, as it provides &eLightning Power&7, which depending on your Thunderwrath upgrade it could be useful to you.

a6899a5c9690.en: &eEnough Knowledge to understand all Tier IV Builds. Good job.

c74cc6fd858b.en: &eHint:&7 You masterized the builds, but what about your artifacts? Try doing some Mythical Challenges with them.

bf6c438b6253.en: &7Your next upgrade as a off-tank is to make Crimson Guard Armor.

773febbd5a07.en: &7You can choose &9Decaying Devotion &7for a more dps focus, or &9Bone Armor&7 for pure resistance with a taunt.

29f8ca68cc3a.en: &7As for Fate, you can choose whichever you prefer more.

4ca7e0228963.en: &7Obtain the &9Apophis&7 Artifact Weapon and use its Upgrade Tree to either go more defensive(recommended with other players) with the oath of protection or go on the full offensive with the oath of Healing. The choice is yours.

301021d7ef0f.en: &7Upgrading your Holy Weapon will not only increase your overall damage, but there is also a large variety of Holy Weapons you can choose from, even simply swords!

38fd3f7d4323.en: &7Using either Oath is also a great way of determining your playstyle, whilst they are very defensive focused, you have to decide if it is offense or defense you so desire.

57e8255e459e.en: &7Technically a side grade to the Prior Set, this Armor set is great for being a bit more tanky, whilst not losing out too much on damage, it is recommended to pair it with Prior armor pieces.

446f1f5ef265.en: &7A Fun and very interesting Side-Grade is Mariums Guns!

05830d3d44d1.en: &7Here is a List of the Current guns:

09f08d6f09c3.en: &dGatling gun:&r &7Nearly infinite spin time, decent dps but it will slow you down and is a bit inaccurate

8a179a4447f1.en: &dHunter Cannon:&r &7Big boom! This weapon has the highest single target Damage out of them all, with a large cooldown!

6f8803234a3c.en: &dHunter Blunderbuss:&r &7A general jack of all trades, shoots 3 projectiles each doing decent damage and having the highest Velocity out of them all, not the most accurate

2301710c5a1f.en: &dHunter Pistol:&r &7The Blunderbuss' smaller brother is great for anyone who likes to shoot fast and having something to do whilst the other guys are reloading

ae0d06e2d76a.en: &cTermina todos los capitulos de Void's Invasion para desbloquear la campaña de esta expansión.

60af2e5df956.en: &7&oEons ago, S'kellak fought against the eldritch beings, defeating and imprisoning the primordial being C'thulhu.

0d7549c45512.en: &7&oWhile its followers escaped, the chains imprisoning its half-brother, a tall hooded monster with tentacles, were broken free. S'kellak couldn't stop his escape, and for eons he never saw him again.

e9170c94698f.en: &7&oUntil now, after the attempt at domination from the remaining forces of the void, all realms lie the weakest they've been.

5d63dab2838c.en: &e&oThe King in Yellow is back, and won't stop until all realms succumb to his new reign.

8c5060502f8c.en: &7&oHace eones, S'kellak luchó contra los seres ancestrales, derrotando y encarcelando al ser primordial C'thulhu.

8f6514774c76.en: &7&oMientras sus seguidores escapaban, las cadenas que aprisionaban a su medio hermano, un monstruo alto encapuchado con tentáculos, se rompieron. S'kellak no pudo detener su escape, y durante eones no lo volvió a ver.

c2c7edd3ec1b.en: &7&oHasta que después del intento de dominación de las fuerzas restantes del vacío, todos los reinos se hallan en su punto más débil.

12f3005d9cf1.en: &e&oEl Rey de Amarillo ha vuelto, y no se detendrá hasta que todos los reinos sucumban a su nuevo reinado.

ed0fa1c39582.en: &7&oI have confirmed that it's him, the primordial being of all unholy things, known as Hastur.

5d714e9f039c.en: &7&oThe Overworld is not safe, Hastur is great at twisting the minds of others, I will need you to come to Vaaz as soon as you can, before one of his twisted slaves come after you.

e48038b7d9a5.en: &7&oUse this beacon in the overworld, and I'll bring you to Vaaz.

a32ceb648fd5.en: &7&oAlso enchant your weapon with Smite, Hastur's followers are undead. You should be prepared for the worst."

3ffd26218fd9.en: &7&oHe confirmado que es él, el ser primordial de todas las cosas profanas, conocido como Hastur.

8f090c983e6b.en: &7&oEl Overworld no está a salvo, Hastur es experto en retorcer las mentes de los seres. Necesito que vengas a Vaaz tan pronto como puedas, antes de que uno de sus esclavos retorcidos venga tras de ti.

7a0bea25efa0.en: &7&oUsa este faro en el Overworld, y te traeré a Vaaz.

edab95d47398.en: &7&oTambién encanta tu arma con Castigo, los seguidores de Hastur son no-muertos. Debes estar preparado para lo peor."

46b3bcc4ac39.en: &7The once archmage and leader of the Hex, dead in the hands of the Champions of Vaaz, was been resurrected by Hastur himself.

3f6896a878b9.en: &7Now part of the cult and infused with Hastur's power, he has been chosen to sabotage the plans of S'kellak. Kidnapping and killing anyone who tries to travel to the Cinderstone Depths.

668bf6f58f62.en: &eUse Smite to shred his barrier if you don't have the required spell power!

ecaaf0628566.en: &7El pasado archimago y líder de los Hex, muerto a manos de los Campeones de Vaaz, ha sido resucitado por el mismísimo Hastur.

f4213f991d31.en: &7Ahora, como parte del culto e infundido con el poder de Hastur, ha sido elegido para sabotear los planes de S'kellak. Secuestrando y matando a cualquiera que intente viajar a las Profundidades de Piedraceniza.

e404fc4d313c.en: &eUsa Castigo para romper su barrera si no tienes el poder de hechizo requerido!

fc27999767bf.en: &7Signal this beacon in the overworld to travel to Vaaz and meet S'kellak.

a4abc4a6564f.en: &7Llama este faro en el Overworld para viajar a Vaaz y encontrarte con S'kellak.

5d33f6dea8d4.en: &eUse the Beacon of Hope and Travel to Vaaz

22ecbe6e119f.en: &7&oCorruption Infusions can be used to add corruption to Armor Pieces, which are useful for corruption scaled abilities.

eb70852569b5.en: &7&oActive Abilities from the Talent Tree have special effects and scaling with Corruption.

f0737a198ff6.en: &7The Corruption Infusion Template can be found as loot in end cities.

8a7e6a77bae7.en: &eUse in a Smithing Table along with the desired item and a material.

ef7873817132.en: &7&oLas Infusiones de Corrupción pueden ser usadas para añadir corrupción a piezas de Armadura, lo cual es útil para habilidades que escalan con la corrupción.

022399efd77b.en: &7&oLas Habilidades Activas del Árbol de Talentos tienen efectos especiales y escalan con la Corrupción.

bc6ed4b8c0d1.en: &7El Molde de Infusión de Corrupción se puede encontrar como botín en las ciudades del End.

0eee7afdfa05.en: &eUsa en una Mesa de Herrería junto con el arma o armadura, y un material.

3b83c66b95d0.en: &7&oEtyr Infusions can be used to add Corruption Resistance to armor pieces, that counteract with your amount of corruption.

031e0c97a4a8.en: &7&oWhile abilities scale with Corruption, negative effects are based on your &nTotal Corruption&r&7&o, which accounts for your Etyr.

154f93111f43.en: &7The Etyr Infusion Template can be found as loot in end cities.

263e3eddfb04.en: &7&oLas Infusiones de Etyr pueden ser usadas para añadir Resistencia a la Corrupción a las piezas de armadura, contrarrestando tu cantidad de corrupción.

801ed7b4d00f.en: &7&oMientras que las habilidades escalan con la Corrupción, los efectos negativos se basan en tu &nCorrupción Total&r&7&o, que tiene en cuenta tu Etyr.

3c97f862f18c.en: &7El Molde de Infusión de Etyr se puede encontrar como botín en las ciudades del End.

89c7ce096369.en: &eUsa en una Mesa de Herrería junto con la armadura y un material.

ae4db94a35e7.en: This quest line is about discovering the unique and quirky items/blocks in Prominence, which could even help with some of the tech mods!

bf351fb2d3a8.en: Blank Plates are the basis towards Effect Plates. Stepping on an Effect Plate will give you the designated effect.

b8b67baa7904.en: &7These Plates can be made by striking them with Lightning.

fc00f164a67c.en: Mob Filters are blocks that only a select few entities can go through.

40f9a2fa5d37.en: Copper pans are an earlygame alternative to ore farms commonly found in tech mods like Create. When putting sand/gravel underneath and water above, they will rarely generate ore nuggets, gravel, emeralds, and a few other miscellaneous items.

0f74138c6de3.en: Cog Blocks are pretty much just redstone but they can be placed in the air.

e9bcb751f47a.en: &7Plates do not apply Enchants, but your Weapon does. This Plate damages mobs until they have 1 HP left, perfect for that Looting 4 Sword.

f1b1211a8e79.en: For when you wanna Hurt Mobs, but kill them yourself

6b08487bdbf5.en: &7Don't Like hand feeding your animals? Thing Trough will take that work off you.

f6895a00f328.en: &7Great way to find out if that wall is 1 block too long 2 hours too late.

9f42beeef33b.en: &7Gliders are one of the best ways to fly before going to the End. These things are affordable and incredibly useful for traversing large areas of land.

4ced6ea48c70.en: Not quite flying, not quite falling

041b02394a19.en: &7The Trash Can is the Apex Predator of an Unorganized Base. Don't need 4000 Stone Swords? Trashy will enjoy the meal!

ddc4ee842a98.en: &7This Staff can be used to Wax certain blocks, instead of doing it manually.

d48fd79290ab.en: &7This block gives a very limited Area of Creative flight. Other Alternatives are the Flügel Tiara and Gravichestplate.

e548ee2e7cd1.en: &7Ever Wanted to go through a wall without hurting your head for once? This item is just perfect for you!

d1ac093a7d69.en: &7Are you an Archer who doesn't know where to put your Arrows? This Quiver is great for Storing tons of arrows.

8a5a6a0f7625.en: &7No Trash Slot in your inventory or backpack? Just carry a comically large Trash Can in your hand, for some reason Don't Question it too long.

8fcc36c078ac.en: &7This Torch can stop any Hostile Spawns in a large area. Great for your base.

999aedb9a411.en: &7Don't like Animals spawning? Just use this torch. You monster.

b92a6fd68a7c.en: &7This Torch will stop fish and other Aquatic animals from spawning, not sure why but this would be a great for a Trident farm.

0bba121b2ebf.en: These stones can be found below the earth, somewhere in the deepslate layers, they aren't really common though.

04afa8449047.en: These two stones are going to be important into the creation of your soul equipment, remember to harvest a lot.

c1353e6ad5ec.en: Lost Souls are another source of power for these soul equipment and block creation, you can find some by smelting soul sand.

ce3a6fa6b1b1.en: Soul Infused Ingots are one of the main ingredients in crafting the soul equipment as they contain the essence of lost souls.

8e6918422104.en: Decorative blocks used in some structures of the great monsters hidden away. Great for a building theme too.

65f986f66c92.en: These Silver Bullets will be very important to your soul ranged weaponry as they are the main use for such bullets. Silver Bullets may be cheap but depending on how often you use it, it'll be your debt.

6cc2b57a5a87.en: The Hunter Pistol is a simple firearm that will use silver bullets but have a fairly quick reload.

55a5ebe6717e.en: The Hunter Blunderbuss is a shotgun that will use up silver bullets to release a blast of projectiles at the targets.

16671580fb23.en: You Can't Talk to a Human, With a Shotgun in Their Hand..

a084f3b62a52.en: The Hunter Cannon is a heavy weapon that requires 10 silver bullets to fire as it'll combine all the bullets into one cannonball shot. It has a long reload so you cannot shoot this in rapid succession easily.

a4aab710b6b5.en: The Gatling Gun is a heavy gun that will take time to load up and start firing at a rapid pace. It'll eat up your bullets quickly so be sure to use this gun only when you have a lot of silver bullets.

85c83c597678.en: Say Hello to my little friend!

0c521668880d.en: Yes, you've read it, it's Big Chungus, gather 9 of these emeralds by killing Chunguses and craft the music disc.

896a2a6b67f5.en: Cheap imitations of what a true soul equipment are, used by fallen fighters such as Remnants.

13b58c4823c8.en: These tools are so durable, that they even might be stronger than diamond.

9113b88a6a87.en: Such a peculiar compass, they seem to be pointing somewhere far away, where do they point to?

40930c83c3b6.en: Here lies a great champion, unable to find peace and rest. You must kill him and send his body back to the earth.

02ed1745b17e.en: Here stands a king who lost it all, end his false reign and emerge victorious.

494dfb0f79ce.en: A powerful soul of a fallen leader and a heart of a decaying demon. You have freed the king who couldn't die.

970a427bbb9b.en: A powerful soul of a great champion and a powerful essence of a ghost. You have freed the dead and now they have fallen back to the earth to rest.

c04b1a63affd.en: A powerful soul who was under control of a dark force and a pure moonstone radiating with powerful energy. But couldn't we have done anything else?

2f1f2ba36575.en: You have brought back a fallen knight to their rightful body, and now you faced him in his former glory.

e8f69ec8d17d.en: A powerful soul of an embodiment of decay, the Wither, and it dropped a shard emanating chaotic energy, what is it for?

36fb8536dd78.en: A powerful soul of the last known dragon in the End. You are now able to harness its power.

300efff6898e.en: The lunar ring grants the wearer the ability to launch magical waves for a short time, granting the wearer to even shoot from afar with just their hands.

25d735083dd7.en: Making use of the moonstone you found, you decided to see if you are able to create a powerful weapon.

c49ec4c0c6d8.en: After inserting a powerful soul into the swords, they now seem to have awakened with the power of the moon.

b31b99662443.en: This sword is interesting, it allows the holder to sense nearby hostiles, may be useful in a raid perhaps?

aa7a7463455a.en: This weapon is a bit weird, it can transform into a different weapon with a different ability when wanted.

956ed8975c95.en: What must compel you to create such an item? To summon a great demon or something evil?

1e10bd8de3af.en: The Smell of Decay is near...

990b35377965.en: &7The Talent Tree, along with leveling, is the most important method of player progression in Prominence, as with it you can increase your stats and unlock new abilities.

b928afeb524a.en: &eFor some boss fights, it's an essential part to be on their required level! The boss' quest will show on its description the recommended level if they do have one.

The Mining Rig Computer allows you to generate ores using rf.

0514da1022a2.en:
Step by step for charging a Core of Modularity: 

1. Place down your capsule with the Laser Emitter(s) facing it with a 3 block gap between it/them and the Capsule. 

2. Place your Core of Modularity (uncharged) in the Capsule.

3. Power the Laser Emitter(s) by routing LF into the back of it/them.

4. Apply a redstone signal to your Laser Emitter(s)

If you want to automate the shutdown of your lasers it may be helpful to know that a comparator outputs a signal when the Capsule is empty or done crafting.

b758cecd2361.en: Used to charge cores of modularity.\n\nBe careful to not apply a redstone signal to your laser emitter when the capsule is empty as this will destroy the capsule. Also, applying a redstone signal to the laser emitter when it's not facing a Capsule will result in it exploding after a bit of time.

4f45e05c7bc5.en: &7Located at its own platform, a giant, eldritch structure that can be found floating in the end. To make it appear, use an eye of ender on the top of its platform.

7ca95b3d74e1.en: &7Obsidilith, el monolito viviente, es el pilar de la influencia del vacío en El End.

f868088aa5f3.en: &7Ubicado en su propia plataforma, una estructura gigantesca y extraña, que se encuentra flotando en El End. Para invocarlo, usa un ojo de ender en la cima de su plataforma.

b1cde84deabe.en: &7The raw essence of the end; the "Ender Eye", has been corrupted by the void's presence, turned into a horrific creature. It now needs to be saved from the void's influence to establish balance in the now desolated dimension.

f68e103db5fe.en: &7The Eye can only be summoned at an Eye Shrine. The Shrine is built with a base of a 5×5 obsidian platform and a 3×3 centered crying obsidian layer. On all four corners an end rod has to get placed. The Eye can only get called in The end dimension.

5e1e7877802a.en: &7La esencia pura del End; el "Ojo del Ender", ha sido corrompida por la presencia del vacío y transformada en una criatura horrorosa. Ahora debe ser salvado de esa maligna influencia para restablecer el equilibrio en la ahora desolada dimensión.

5a80609e2c9a.en: &7El Ojo solo puede ser invocado en un Santuario del Ojo. El Santuario se construye sobre una plataforma de obsidiana de 5x5 y una capa central de obsidiana llorosa de 3x3. En cada uno de los cuatro bordes se debe colocar una vara del end. En la cima del santuario, deberás tú sacrificar el huevo de dragón. El Ojo solo puede ser invocado en la dimensión del End.

1c665c70bd39.en: &7This giant eye serves as the eternal watcher of the Prison of the Damned, residing within its own Lair deep in the Prison.

7c96537afdeb.en: &7To challenge it, thou must first obtain a Vine Rune from the Promenade of the Condemned. With this rune, gain access to the Lair and face the eye in battle.

194745806b0a.en: &7Este ojo gigante sirve como el vigilante eterno de la Prisión de los Condenados, residiendo en su propia Guarida, a las profundidades de la Prisión.

cffaa8f1d9e3.en: &7Para desafiarlo, primero debes obtener una Runa de Vid, obtenida en Paseo de los Condenados. Con esta runa, accede a su Guarida y enfréntate al ojo en batalla.

79de947ddeb0.en: &7&oJean, once a noble and great emerald dragon, hath succumbed to the dark tendrils of the Void. Now corrupted and consumed by the Void's wrath, she dwelleth at the heart of the End, now known as the Ender Dragon.

88f343e93df6.en: &7&oShe is no simple feat, for the Void hath bestowed upon her formidable powers, driven by a strong and unquenchable rage known as the Ender.

f4b7e46e6be9.en: &7&oTo unlock the ancient portal to the End, thou must seek out twelve of the sixteen unique eyes. These eyes are scattered throughout the vast expanse of the Overworld and the burning depths of the Nether.

268a300ac53c.en: &7&oJean, la noble y gran dragona esmeralda, ha sucumbido a las oscuras garras del Vacío. Ahora corrupta y consumida por la ira del mismo, ronda por el corazón del End, conocida ahora como la Dragona del Ender.

f3705bfaef19.en: &7&oElla no es un reto sencillo, pues el Vacío le ha otorgado poderes formidables, impulsados por una furia fuerte e insaciable conocida como el Ender.

f6e6cd7e4de6.en: &7&oPara desbloquear el antiguo portal al End, debes buscar doce de los dieciséis ojos únicos. Estos ojos están esparcidos a lo largo de la vasta extensión del Overworld y las ardientes profundidades del Nether.

06dfe0ea65e5.en: &7&oDeep within Vaaz, the primordial volcano from where everything originated, dwells the Living Statue, S'kellak, creator of all things.

c1c70c0b7ec5.en: &7&oHe upholds the delicate balance across all dimensions and has waged countless battles to stave off the destruction of the realms.

8f50448dc04d.en: &7&oEn las profundidades de Vaaz, el volcán primordial de donde todo se originó, habita la Estatua Viviente, S'kellak, el creador de todo lo que exista.

9bbef12e99e6.en: &7&oÉl mantiene el delicado equilibrio a lo largo de todas las dimensiones y ha luchado incontables batallas para evitar la destrucción de los reinos.

50369a2f065d.en: &o&7Yet now, after eons have passed, S'kellak lays weaker than ever before. A dire shadow blooms, an eldritch force known as The Void.

aed0ad689695.en: &o&7For ages, S'kellak has contained The Void, but with his strength now dwindling, the shadow surges, plotting to breach and destroy all realms. What once were serene beings shall be twisted into deadly aberrations, as corruption spreads its vile tendrils. The time of reckoning draws nigh.

4b7a4ecea4f1.en: &o&7Y ahora, tras eones, S'kellak yace más débil que nunca. Una sombría amenaza florece, una fuerza ancestral, conocida como El Vacío.

2240f1d42c1a.en: &o&7Durante eras, S'kellak ha contenido a este, pero con su poca fuerza, la sombra se alza, tramando corromper y destruir todos los reinos. Aquellos que antes eran seres serenos serán retorcidos en aberraciones mortales, mientras la corrupción extiende sus viles tentáculos. El tiempo de la destrucción se avecina.

e3b2035529ef.en: &o&7S'kellak hath discovered a source of unbalance within the realms. All dimensions now bear the taint of the void's horrid presence.

702157fa8441.en: &o&7Once serene creatures have been twisted into powerful aberrations by its corrupting touch. The fate of the realms rests upon thee.

f03aa2c1af4c.en: &o&7S'kellak descubrió una fuente de desequilibrio en los reinos. Todas las dimensiones ahora llevan la mancha de la horrenda presencia del Vacío.

f2575d7861d5.en: &o&7Las criaturas que antes eran serenas han sido retorcidas en poderosas aberraciones por su toque corruptor. El destino de los reinos descansa sobre ti.

737386429560.en: &7&oWith the defeat of the dimensional threats and the restoration of the realms's balance, S'kellak, The Eternal Flame, spoke directly to the champion.

3e3939fa1ca3.en: &6"In recognition of your valor and dedication,"&r &7&oS'kellak's voice resonated,&r &6"I bestow upon you a fragment of my essence, the Molten Core."

2d3617c89a1f.en: &7This gift, illuminated by S'kellak's power, signifies both the hero's triumph and a pledge of continued protection for the realms.

739451a9d713.en: &7&oCon la derrota de las amenazas, y la restauración del equilibrio de los reinos, S'kellak, El Fuego Eterno, habló directamente al campeón.

a4bfe22fb4c1.en: &6"En reconocimiento a tu valor y dedicación,"&r &7&oLa voz de S'kellak resonó,&r &6"te otorgo un fragmento de mi esencia, el Núcleo Fundido."

f84d139c9606.en: &7Este regalo, iluminado por el gran poder de S'kellak, simboliza tanto el triunfo del héroe como una promesa de protección continua de los reinos.

b0ae30533a60.en: &7The Ender's Essence has been defeated, but its essence escaped the empty void, and a rift was formed in the End. Something is coming.

4761f43d2800.en: &7Deep in the end, strange voices are now whispering &8&o"The King in Yellow is near"&r.

f2d9a8c990fb.en: &7La Esencia del Ender ha sido derrotada, pero su esencia escapó del vacío vacío, y una grieta se ha formado en el End. Algo se acerca.

97ce31106ce0.en: &7En lo profundo del End, extrañas voces ahora susurran &8&o"El Rey en Amarillo se aproxima"&r.

092821bd7a81.en: &eThe invasion has been halted, for now.&r

045dca4eb80a.en: &6"We must prepare for what lies ahead — a new form of magic that we're unfamiliar with, known as the corruption. I'll go on a quest to discover a new material that could offer us a fighting chance against it.

380ac2112450.en: &6As for you, that molten core is nothing but a vessel. You will need the essences of ancient beings. Once harnessed, these essences will empower it to be able to forge the formidable artifacts. It is your mission to obtain them." &e&oS'kellak explained.

b2b97386c3e5.en: &eLa invasión ha sido detenida, por ahora.&r

e6d4d2ec2bb3.en: &6"Debemos prepararnos para lo que se avecina — una nueva forma de magia que desconocemos, conocida como la corrupción. Iré en busca de un nuevo material que podría darnos una oportunidad contra ella.

a0ba2ad1483d.en: &6En cuanto a ti, ese Núcleo Fundido no es más que un recipiente. Necesitarás las esencias de seres antiguos. Una vez dominadas, estas esencias lo empoderarán para forjar armas de artefacto. Tu misión es obtenerlas." &e&oexplicó S'kellak.

817d4c1f9274.en: &7Baphomet, the Ancient Great Demon of Magic, holds a powerful demonic essence.

98cc528734f2.en: &7To summon it you must make a complex ritual using dark magic, which can be read using the Book of Shadows. This will require some work because no Novice is worthy to summon a Great Demon on their first Ritual, progress through the Book of Shadows to become a worthy summoner!

6ef492097dd1.en: &7By using the Essence of Eventide on the Old Moon Altar, you will return the true heir back to its original body. This will result in the summoning of the Fallen Icon, a fierce empowered version of the Returning Knight with a fast and dangerous second phase. When summoned, it will affect anyone nearby with Weakness, Nausea, and Slowness.

84584b1f1895.en: &7Al usar la Essence of Eventide en el Antiguo Altar Lunar, devolverás al verdadero heredero a su cuerpo original. Esto resultará en la invocación del Ícono Caído, una versión feroz y más fuerte del Antiguo Campeón, con una segunda fase rápida y peligrosa. Al ser invocado, dará Debilidad, Náuseas y Lentitud a quienes estén cerca.

9b46c27d69fe.en: &7Must use the Shell Horn, found in the Deep Frozen Ocean. Call upon her in the Ice Maze, near water.

44b781402320.en: &7When fought, may she be weakened, or else she shall not die.

feedd26f01d2.en: &7Debes usar el Cuerno encontrado en el Profundo Océano Congelado. Llámala en el Laberinto de Hielo, cerca del agua.

da37e8f7bcd2.en: &7Al luchar, debe ser debilitada, o de lo contrario no caerá.

0066c435f873.en: &7From the spirit of a great leader

41f9c48a09dd.en: &7The primitive seed of creation, the &9Primordial Abyss&7 has the most influence by the cosmic horrors. It is a corrupted land with its own corrupted kind of life, known as the &9aberrations&7.

759ff561ca0d.en: &7La semilla primitiva de la creación, el &9Abismo Primordial&7, tiene la mayor influencia de los horrores cósmicos. Es una tierra corrompida con su propia forma de vida corrupta, conocidas como las &9aberraciones&7.

ea84e381c8f3.en: &7The hasturian wastes are a desolated land full of spikes that are known as the &eSpire Spikes&7. Some of these spikes have an unknown metal blessed by Hastur. It could be the best way to fight against corruption.

6d7c27411320.en: &7El desierto hasturiano es una tierra desolada llena de picos que son conocidos como los &ePinchos de Espiral&7. Algunos de estos picos contienen un metal desconocido, bendecido por Hastur. Podría ser la mejor manera de luchar contra la corrupción.

ed0b31674a3f.en: &7With the defeat of the The Eye, the end has been affected by the void's higher forces, &dthe cosmic horrors&7. Eldritch beings that hold pure corruption in their veins.

69fab892f95a.en: &7Con la derrota de El Ojo, el End ha sido afectado por las fuerzas superiores del vacío, &dlos horrores cósmicos&7. Seres ancestrales que llevan corrupción pura en sus venas.

16ccbb8e017a.en: &eThe Aberrations.&7 They are horrific creatures that live in the Primordial Abyss. Be careful with them, when they hit you, they will apply &9corruption&7 to you, which is stackable. You don't want them to hit you multiple times.

68a191079000.en: &eLas Aberraciones.&7 Son criaturas horribles que habitan en el Abismo Primordial. Ten cuidado con ellas, cuando te golpean, te aplican &9corrupción&7, la cual es acumulable. No querrás que te golpeen varias veces.

3e0077b6d1df.en: &7The metal from the Spire Spikes, &2Etyr&7, has an unique attribute, it is &2resistant to corruption&7. We could use this metal to prevent the cosmic horrors from corrupting the end.

040af4e90c4a.en: &7El metal de los Picos de Agujas, &2Etyr&7, tiene una propiedad única: es &2resistente a la corrupción&7. Podríamos usar este metal para evitar que los horrores cósmicos corrompan el End.

caff600553b0.en: &6"Let's start the preparations for the summoning.

5de319433a7b.en: &6First, we will need a summoning pedestal." &e&oS'kellak explained.

77a774b3f92e.en: &6Primero, necesitaremos un pedestal de invocación." &e&oexplicó S'kellak.

25ec06d46953.en: &6"There isn't anything more durable for this than cinderstone, forged directly from the depths of Vaaz. This should be enough to trap its essence, but I'm afraid that I don't know what you could unleash on the process" &e&oS'kellak said

93c0a7dc5036.en: &6"No hay nada más duradero para esto que la piedraceniza, forjada directamente en las profundidades de Vaaz. Esto debería ser suficiente para atrapar su esencia, pero me temo que no sé lo que podrías desatar en el proceso." &e&oDijo S'kellak.

efbaa39338c3.en: &6"It is waiting for you. Bring that pedestal to the End and place two of the end's essences you have found there, an ender pearl and a end crystal. Be prepared, and don't forget to trap it. You have my blessing, child." &e&oS'kellak said

d73b96077c4b.en: &6"Te está esperando. Lleva ese pedestal al End y coloca dos esencias del End, una perla de ender y un cristal del End. Prepárate, y no olvides atraparlo. Tienes mi bendición, mi joven." &e&oDijo S'kellak.

40681bbf0cf5.en: &7Deep inside the end's rift, a human sized being can be seen casting an unknown spell. Your ritual will be able to interrupt it, and force it to come at you.

b89276989b0a.en: &7Null is a powerful and agile boss, it will teleport every time you hit him, and will spawn minions to attack you. Make sure to never stop attacking it, or else it'll heal.

7b1d09c5201a.en: &7En lo profundo de la grieta del End, se puede ver una figura del tamaño de un humano lanzando un hechizo desconocido. Tu ritual podrá interrumpirlo y obligarlo a enfrentarte.

7cc5ccc7dcfb.en: &7Null es un jefe poderoso y ágil; se teletransportará cada vez que lo golpees y convocará esbirros para atacarte. Asegúrate de no dejar de atacarlo, o de lo contrario se curará.

9ff65a66b42b.en: &6"This is not over yet. That was nothing but a shadow, and now with this rift, I'm afraid we won't be able to do this.

02d3bff5bbae.en: &r&6Unless... we use their own power against them. We could trap one of the heralds of the void inside a vessel, and with it, gather their power. But first, make yourself a better weapon, I'll make the vessel."&e&o S'kellak said.

502bf3aed4d8.en: &eFollow the &cS'kellak's Forge&e questline for more information on forging artifact weapons.

c60cc88189cf.en: &6"Esto aún no ha terminado. Eso no era más que una sombra, y ahora, con esta grieta, temo que no podramos hacerlo.

e7b45e590ea3.en: &r&6A menos que... usemos su propio poder contra ellos. Podríamos atrapar a uno de los heraldos del vacío dentro de un recipiente, y con él, obtener su poder. Pero primero, fabrícate una mejor arma, yo haré el recipiente."&e&o dijo S'kellak.

540195a9db1f.en: &eSigue la línea de misiones de la &cS'kellak's Forge&e para más información sobre la creación de armas artefacto.

9d0f3ff1a0ef.en: &7&oRight before Null's imprisonment, it successfuly casted the spell. A big monstrous creature appeared from the rift

fc49d5ba091e.en: &6"The Faceless One is here, another of the void heralds, and the root of corruption" &e&oS'kellak said

5fbb3fd5d25e.en: &7&oJusto antes del encarcelamiento de Null, logró lanzar el hechizo con éxito. Una gran criatura monstruosa apareció desde la grieta.

2805b211708f.en: &6"El Ignoto está aquí, otro de los heraldos del vacío, y el origen de la corrupción" &e&oDijo S'kellak.

79f46e010c87.en: &dMythic Challenges&7 are endgame encounters unlocked after beating Null. They are void-infused nightmares created by the now unleashed Faceless being.

801b00321d92.en: &7Each successful fight will grant you a new hourglass with a higher level. The higher the level, the stronger the nightmare is.

34a193baa6bb.en: &cDying against a mythic boss will fail the challenge, and summon a new lower level hourglass.

1250941b62c3.en: &7You can summon them with a &dVoid Hourglass&7. If you misplaced your hourglass, you can get a new one from Null, but its level will be 1.

f9f2c8dac81a.en: &dLos Desafíos Míticos&7 son encuentros de final de juego que se desbloquean tras derrotar a Null. Son pesadillas infundidas con el vacío, creadas por el ser Ignoto que ha sido liberado.

d6ffabdc9925.en: &7Cada combate exitoso te otorgará un nuevo reloj de arena con un nivel superior. Cuanto mayor sea el nivel, más fuerte será la pesadilla.

2e32e41d7b3f.en: &cMorir contra un jefe mítico fallará el desafío y convocará un nuevo reloj de arena de un nivel inferior.

43a436439039.en: &7Puedes invocarlos con un &dReloj de Arena del Vacío&7. Si perdiste tu reloj de arena, puedes obtener uno nuevo de Null, pero su nivel será 1.

c34567314c16.en: &7At the heart of the void's influence, the Primordial Abyss, you may summon the herald of the void, the gruntling faceless being with its dark ritual, by breaking the heart of an aberration on the middle.

e2a4d3d089d4.en: &6"Beware, just weaken it, and I'll attempt to bring it down to Vaaz to trap it for eternity. The fate of the realms is on you." &eS'kellak said

ee3b5a6401e9.en: &7En el corazón de la influencia del vacío, el Abismo Primordial, puedes invocar al heraldo del vacío, el ser ignoto, con su oscuro ritual, rompiendo el corazón de una aberración en el centro.

6158932e6bd3.en: &6"Ten cuidado, solo debilítalo, y yo intentaré llevarlo a Vaaz para atraparlo por la eternidad. El destino de los reinos está en tus manos." &eDijo S'kellak.

489b2c06e879.en: &9Summon and fight against The Faceless One

6e045219abd8.en: &7Magus, the leader of the Hex, is one of the keys for the void to get into the Overworld. He hasn't been corrupted, but he's driven on his own interests and made an accord with the void.

ed045fe9b8fb.en: &7He's a powerful mage, its barrier may be weak to certain elements, but the Smite enchant will also help break it.

d4265c1d3664.en: &eUsing magic or abilities will gather the attention of the Hex. You can also craft a Hexblade offering to summon the Magisters. Kill the Magisters to potentially get a Hexblade and a prismatic Pearl. Use the Hexblade on their portal to travel to the Glass Ocean and use a Prismatic Pearl to summon him.

2e6b708c9644.en: &7Magus, el líder de los Hex, es una de las claves para que el vacío llegue al Overworld. No ha sido corrompido, pero está impulsado por sus propios intereses y ha hecho un pacto con el vacío.

683d9eeaaf49.en: &7Es un poderoso mago, su barrera puede ser débil ante ciertos elementos, pero el encantamiento Golpeo también ayudará a romperla.

22630b44aa23.en: &eUsar magia o habilidades va a atraer la atención de los Hex. Usa una Hexblade en su portal para viajar al Océano de Cristal, y usa una Perla Prismatica para invocarlo.

f378d43df829.en: &6"To summon the last herald, you'll have to go through their own dark magic. You should make a weapon born of true corruption, The Dreadtide, to get yourself mad to attract the dark thoughts from the void, the All-Seeing Eyes; we'll need 4 of them for the ritual.

fd0c70603a3e.en: &6While you do this, I'll find more knowledge on the ritual. Just beware, don't fall into madness, as there's no going back." &e&oS'kellak said

fd3bb263bd6c.en: &6"Para invocar al último heraldo, tendrás que utilizar su propia magia oscura. Deberías forjar un arma nacida de la verdadera corrupción, la Dreadtide, para enloquecer y atraer los pensamientos más oscuros del vacío, los Ojos Omniscientes; necesitaremos 4 de ellos para el ritual.

54c107b8f097.en: &6Mientras haces esto, buscaré más conocimiento sobre el ritual. Solo ten cuidado, no caigas en la locura, ya que no hay vuelta atrás." &e&oDijo S'kellak.

bcb3cf7ed955.en: &eObtain 4 Ominous Eyes from the All-Seeing Eyes

a93883b8d629.en: &6"I have found one of the lost pages of the Necronomicon, this should help you with the ritual. The Necronomicon also states that this ritual has to be done in the Primordial abyss." &e&oS'kellak said

934e4f937e9a.en: &6"He encontrado una de las páginas perdidas del Necronomicón, esto debería ayudarte con el ritual. El Necronomicón establece que este ritual debe realizarse en el abismo Primordial." &e&oDijo S'kellak.

3d196461b247.en: &7The Faceless One has been captured and trapped inside Vaaz, S'kellak interrogated it.

6ec74df90c54.en: &9"C' mgepmgah, llll h', c'den ephaiagl ot e'enhe, ymg' ahorna mgah ahf''s nog, ymg' ahorna mgah uh'eog ph'nglui turor" &e&oThe Faceless said, in an unknown tongue

1ab95ce89534.en: &6"My child, if what it says is true, then our war has just started." &e&oSaid S'kellak, worried.

7d2fb50b5837.en: &8&oDeep within the end, the rift closes, and a dark portal opens.

25026abb331a.en: &7El Ignoto ha sido capturado y atrapado dentro de Vaaz, S'kellak lo interrogó.

c61ef82e3773.en: &9"C' mgepmgah, llll h', c'den ephaiagl ot e'enhe, ymg' ahorna mgah ahf''s nog, ymg' ahorna mgah uh'eog ph'nglui turor" &e&oDijo el Ignoto, en una lengua desconocida.

61beb3fbe4e0.en: &6"Mi joven, si lo que dice es cierto, entonces nuestra guerra apenas comienza." &e&oDijo S'kellak, preocupado.

013a53bd2bb5.en: &8&oEn lo profundo del End, la grieta se cierra, y un portal oscuro se abre.

ddcf7a5e6de8.en: &cBetter suitable for Melee. Check out the Nether Questline for more info.

44a1ddfd3162.en: &7Found in the Nether, he was cursed by what he thought was his allies. His kingdom was sieged and fell under the lava sea, and the King could only watch helplessly while his mind and body was slowly withering away.

04edb96218e5.en: &7Encontrado en el Nether, fue maldecido por quienes pensaba que eran sus aliados. Su reino fue sitiado y cayó bajo el mar de lava, y el Rey solo pudo observar impotente mientras su mente y cuerpo se desmoronaban lentamente.

3571d9aecbff.en: Use a Moonstone Compass to locate the Decaying Kingdom

181d6e21bcc4.en: &eCampaign bosses have their own level, just like you do as seen at the top of your inventory.

7866b6fe5aca.en: &cThis means that if you are not of a high enough level, you will not deal enough damage to kill them.

24ec3748bd40.en: &7In total you will deal &c10% less damage per level difference&7, meaning if you're level 45 and a boss is level 50, you'll deal only 50% of the total damage you're meant to deal.

9c138f230767.en: &7Youve gotten word that about 1 in every 125 Aberrations is mutated to some degree. Chances are low but maybe this could be another Method of getting Omnious Eyes.

d5493af17f7d.en: &eThese Eyes will have to do too...

93d712edfb66.en: Remember, this guidebook is very very important in order to progress in case you're lost on what to do. Please take the time and read them when needed.

3adbd9e36d44.en: Hello, young technician! I am here to help guide you through the factory world of Modern Industrialization. It may be a bit overwhelming at first, but it won't hurt too much, right?

e6e1071c8041.en: Such a piece of equipment is surely gonna be important for our uses! It feels like we're doing blacksmith work!

c3d923a52060.en: Steam machines will accept inputs from any side, be it items, steam or another fluid. You can lock their slots by clicking on the lock in the interface. Locked slots only accept one type of item or fluid.

f117a0dcbbba.en: Full Steam Ahead! You have now made it to this point of learning how tech works, are you ready for more?

71bfbbe12e8a.en: This is probably the first machine you will want to build as it saves your hammer from hammering away their durability.

a7809dc9aedd.en: Steam machines need steam to function, and that's exactly what the boiler provides. It will slowly use fuel to heat up. When it's hot enough, it will start to produce steam. Don't forget to feed it with water or your fuel will burn for nothing.

7da5ec1a0dce.en: You can also smelt water buckets into steam buckets. Make your first Bronze Compressor before the boiler to save a lot on the plates!

c2c1f549b547.en: It probably looks expensive to you right now, but don't forget that you can triple ores with the Forge Hammer. Also, as soon as you will have your first two machines, it will become more than twice less expensive!

73acb32a1134.en: The boiler will automatically produce and send steam to adjacent machines, up to 8 millibuckets per tick.

b54f14aa17d1.en: Bronze machines can only process recipes up to 2 EU/t, meaning that the recipe will use 2 Energy Units per Tick. As 1 millibucket of steam = 1 EU, a boiler at max temperature can power 4 machines simultaneously!

f0bca04248fe.en: Oh, That's Hot! Remember that the boiler is an advanced machinery that is able to power several machines at once and saves fuel efficiently. Don't forget to give it water or else the fuel wastes burning to ashes.

8278a06a0512.en: The Steam Blast Furnace has a similar structure like the Coke Oven, but this is used to create steel. Perhaps this is where the next stage comes.

7f76a6dc9435.en: The Macerator is an interesting machine that allows the recycling of materials and powder them into dust and be reused again.

515305a37e86.en: This is a miner's trusty item that will mine tunnels in a 3x3 manner. Remember to always refuel with water and coal like a steam engine!

6316b45cecd2.en: My Drill Will Pierce the Heavens!

b3dcba10a579.en: The Mixer will help you mix dusts or fluids for a cheaper price. Just don't put your food ingredients in here, or it'll smell bad.

804aad1fc405.en: Now this is a perfect machine used to save your materials from being wasted! Use it to cut into any machine part you need, at the cost of some lubricant.

dfc5122bc448.en: Dust to dust! Clay to bricks! Making these bricks aren't particularly hard, just turn regular bricks into dust, mix it with some clay and smelt.

6fc36f827ea8.en: Where's the Fire in Fire Clay?

075504570ee8.en: The Bronze Furnace is just as slow as a normal furnace, but it uses steam instead of any other fuel source, and cheaper as well.

1d3308b9b3e7.en: Coke will be very useful for steel, but it is also a powerful fuel.

62c10b19a42f.en: I hope that you can find a convenient location for your input and output hatches so it will run smoothly.

562130e54bec.en: The Coke Oven is meant to make coke fuel, not soda. Remember to power this oven with steam using the input hatch and it will give coke in the output hatch. Always carry a wrench in order to see the multiblock structure.

4963c0f1328e.en: Coke is a useful fuel source that is much more powerful than any fuel source, and it is a small requirment for what is to come.

36f31eba730b.en: The Bronze Pump is good at inserting water into your machinery that requires water, especially boilers. Make sure they're near a water source in order for this to work automatically!

c1c5d9ae233d.en: Perfect! Now we can move our fluids properly now! Though it only works with one type of fluid at a time.

8a3eed7c3ad2.en: Steel is the next upgrade to such advanced machinery as it was not only complicated to reach this point, but also shows your ability to think ahead.

4f5bb96fa5be.en: &8A Kilogram of Feathers or A Kilogram of Steel?

5804baf68da4.en: It is time to upgrade your bronze machinery into their steel variants, they have evolved even further than you can imagine.

12fd5cb4c2ff.en: You Live, You Learn, You Upgrade

1c9020033821.en: The Steam Quarry is a steam multiblock machine that consumes bronze drills, uses them to dig deeper than the bedrock and gives you back some ores, as you can see in REI.

9b99cb369162.en: It's recommended that you have multiple SBFs running before you attempt to build it because it requires a lot of steel.

84eba1644d3c.en: Here we are, it is time to assemble a Steam Quarry, an advanced machinery that uses bronze drills to dig for ores. This will be an expensive machinery but it will be one of your greatest investments of all.

afd3d46681f9.en: Now we're cooking, perhaps there is more to this quarry than just this drill, maybe we can advance even further?

e5ed877bbe3f.en: A Steel Wiremill will be useful to create even more sophisticated machinery, but also remember that you need some raw synthetic oil and paper to make rubber sheets and more.

9d9cf959f082.en: Do not tangle up the wires, okay?

1e79387c497b.en: Let's start small first. You never know how this will turn out.

215ea4dd8276.en: You have done well to make it this far. Now that we have moved on from steam, we are now doing even more complicated machinery using electricity, but the results are rewarding.

2a5e05fd6bc9.en: Now we can force items to be transported! Remember to force a connection with the pipes into machineries so they will transport them when needed.

b116af81a990.en: The Assembler is a sophisticated machinery that will automate almost all of your machinery parts, but remember to make more of them to make it easier.

d2024b37118b.en: I feel like we're creating a Steam Engine with how much bigger these boilers get. Anyway, this is an upgraded version of your already known boilers, they use up more fuel but their output is tremendous.

707b305c25ac.en: Can we boil our food now? No?

ac5a4807a0f1.en: The Steam Turbine uses steam to produce electricity. But there will be more upgrades to this certain turbine so remember to make a lot of these to power your electrical machinery.

df173d3206e0.en: The Polarizer is a unique machinery that adds in magnet like properties to certain machinery parts that will be essential.

1c04daf951aa.en: The electric version of the Steam Blast Furnace, nothing more, nothing less. But it does add more recipes that can only be done with this furnace.

3c090012d9cb.en: Oh dear me, this was such a headache, but now we're going even further beyond? I hope I don't get a headache..

ead0874e4df2.en: Will turn various fluids into their lighter parts. So this is how we get distilled water?

ca4e013a80fd.en: These tools will be powerful and potentially replace your pickaxe and shovel. The jetpack will also fly faster with better fuel, handle with care.

a5f2d814b2f6.en: &bIs it a Jet Engine or a Diesel Engine?

fa2532bfc154.en: A Digital World! Finally, we're at this stage, where things get even more ridiculously complex. Remember to read carefully.

ab515128af34.en: A huge multiblock that can dig for Crude Oil under the bedrock using fluid pipes. I hope we can sell all this oil for money... wait, do we have money at all?

1c9e9e0e084f.en: Can make items and fluids react with each other.

b2901997529a.en: This is a very advanced machinery that is fairly tall with how they're able to assemble to an even taller machinery. If you would like to change the height, right click it with a screwdriver and it applies to other multiblocks with multiple shapes like the Kanthal tier Electric Blast Furnace!

e435d45278ca.en: You can use a Heat Exchanger to recover the HP water for another cycle.

3b9e0461615b.en: Turbo Upgrades will be useful to speed up your machinery when right clicked with it while the Advanced Machine Hulls will be used on machines to accept MV only as they're a higher tier. Both can be removed using a crowbar when necessary.

9c06e88963d2.en: Splits items by spinning them very fast.

0522ef036934.en: Provide it with items and energy, and watch your resources GO BRRR!

f45c362f493e.en: Its structure is exactly the same as the Steam Quarry's.

94add6708f56.en: The electric equivalent of the Steam Quarry.

abcc04bd6cd1.en: You are almost there! With oil processing, you're a few steps closer to making even more advanced machinery.

848c6a5f376c.en: I wonder if this steam turbine can blow us away? Nah.

97b1558f9619.en: Another option for small setups is to use an HV steam turbine, they are not a joke with their production.

7655012a6703.en: The Vacuum Freezer is what it sounds like, it cools down or freezes solids and liquids in order to make them usable.

98bc9e8af28b.en: I hope it's safe to put ice cream in here.

f5cbe1bd2e51.en: Can split materials into their different parts using strong electric currents.

670f11392fb0.en: Smelting stainless steel dust in an EBF will give you hot ingots, which you can cool back into regular ingots with a Vacuum Freezer.

f95a7003e3fa.en: Stainless Steel, another necessary ingot used for new stuff. Wait.. I see a stain here!

0a142e5f97ce.en: Kanthal Coils are used by the Electric Blast Furnace to produce more materials as they are powerful enough to do so.

15979f06c3e8.en: This is not an easy metal to work with, remember that you need machinery to even bend this, but it shows its durability.

8db30a8e3382.en: A Processing Unit is used to create highly sophisticated machine parts and even highly advanced drills that are already difficult to make use of.

b2442bc67cc5.en: This blastproof alloy plate is going to be specially important with a specific process that will be booming.

1d1ea2afe9ab.en: Can we make a shield out of this?

0f27c6480dc4.en: A new multiblock made of titanium that can turn water into HP (high pressure) water, steam into HP steam, and the other way around.

47c86a642ef7.en: A specialized chestplate that is used to grant the wearer fall damage protection and creative flight, but will not protect the wearer from any external damage. It must be powered in order to use.

2661bf12f1eb.en: The upper part of the structure accepts Nuclear Item or Fluid Hatches (or simple casings). Those are the inputs and outputs of the reactor.

90e157718c96.en: Each hatch has one input (either item or fluid) and two outputs. The input slots will form a grid, displayed in the reactor GUI (accessible by right-clicking on the controller).

5dbc43cf14d6.en: Each hatch has a temperature and stores heat which can be dissipated in several ways. The heat will naturally move to an adjacent hatch or to the outside if the hatch is on the edge (the heat is then lost). The speed of this process is equal to the hatches content's heat transfer coefficient (shown in REI) times the temperature difference. The heat can also be extracted in a fluid hatch by producing steam. A temperature above an item's maximum temperature will destroy it.

1ce32f627728.en: The core nuclear reactor elements are neutrons. Those are produced by the nuclear fuel. There are two type of neutrons, fast and thermal : the fast carry energy while the thermal do not. Neutrons move in a straight line until they encounter an element or exit the reactor (for fast neutrons, their energy is then lost). The flow of neutrons is shown in the reactor GUI.

5dd9aa3b2d81.en: When a neutron encounters a non-empty hatch, two things can happen : the neutron is absorbed or scattered. A scattered neutron will randomly change direction. If the scattered neutron is fast, it has a chance of slowing down, becoming a thermal one. This transfers the energy from the neutron to the hatch in the form of heat. An absorbed neutron stops its course and also transfers its energy if it was a fast neutron.

899977dacb37.en: The number of absorbed neutrons in a single hatch can be seen in the GUI. The probability for each processes is shown in REI. Those will strongly depend on the hatch's content and the neutron type (fast or thermal). Nuclear fuels absorb thermal neutrons far better.

fa1da82efd95.en: When a neutron, either fast or thermal, is absorbed in nuclear fuel, more neutrons are generated. Those are always fast neutrons and have random direction. Their generation is accompanied by the direct release of energy in the form of additional heat in the hatch.

9f4ee6a61a63.en: Above a certain threshold, the number of generated neutrons will decrease with the temperature until reaching zero. This process wastes some energy, but guarantees the stability of the reactor. The number of generated neutrons (and effective efficiency), the direct energy and the temperature threshold are in REI.

211188bffd16.en: Each nuclear component has maximum number of absorptions. When reached, the item is either destroyed or transformed into a depleted version. This is particularly useful for nuclear fuel because some part of the U238 is transformed into Plutonium in the depleted version, meaning some of it can be transformed back into fuel.

c545280dd571.en: The same thing happens for fluids: a bit of fluid is transformed after each neutron absorption. This can be used to mass produce useful isotopes like deuterium and tritium. In both cases, the outcome is shown in REI.
